text.description_html:
Brass Accents Decorative Apollo Door Pull Plate 3-5/8" Wide x 18" High

This decorative door pull plate is from the Brass Accents Renaissance Collection. Highly detailed solid cast brass styled in Italian Renaissance, popular around the turn of last century.

Brass Accents provides distinctive craftsmanship with old-world tradition for a lifetime of elegance, hand finished in the USA. They are one of the worlds leading crafters of decorative hot-forged and cast brass door hardware.

Also available: Matching Decorative Apollo Push Plate

Specifications for Brass Accents A04-P5231 Decorative Apollo Pull Plate:

  • Plate Width: 3-5/8"
  • Plate Height: 18"
  • Pull Handle Length: 7"
  • Pull Handle Projection: 2"
  • Material: Cast Brass
  • Finish Warranty: 10 Years

Comes complete with matching finish mounting screws for easy installation. Hand rubbed and finished in the USA with a 10 year warranty.
